mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_purchase_item ( purchase_id, product_id, condition_desc, device_no, quantity, unit_price, total_amount, check_status, remark, created_at, updated_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{purchaseId}, #{productId}, #{conditionDesc}, #{deviceNo}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{totalAmount}, #{checkStatus}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT pi.id, pi.product_id, p.product_code, p.product_name, pt.type_name AS product_type_name, p.brand, p.model, p.specification, pi.condition_desc, pi.device_no, pi.quantity, pi.unit_price, pi.total_amount, pi.check_status, pi.remark FROM biz_purchase_item pi INNER JOIN biz_product p ON p.id = pi.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN biz_product_type pt ON pt.id = p.product_type_id AND pt.deleted = 0 WHERE pi.purchase_id = #{purchaseId} AND pi.deleted = 0 ORDER BY pi.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_purchase_item SET condition_desc = #{conditionDesc}, device_no = #{deviceNo}, remark = #{remark}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND purchase_id = #{purchaseId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE biz_purchase_item SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE purchase_id = #{purchaseId} AND deleted = 0
